args.message:
fix(money): use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding per FIN-212

round_money documented banker's rounding but used ROUND_HALF_UP, so
half-cent amounts were rounded away from zero instead of to the nearest
even cent. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match FIN-212 and the
expectations in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: fix(money): use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails on `tests/test_money.py`. `round_money` documents banker's rounding per FIN-212 but was calling `quantize(..., ROUND_HALF_UP)`, so half-cent values were rounded away from zero instead of to the nearest even cent:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675"))` returned `2.68` ✅ (coincidentally correct)
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` ❌ (expected `2.66`)

## Fix
Switch the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`. Docstring behavior and FIN-212 now match the tests.

## Testing
CI on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` at `08d3cd5986`: passed ✅ (`tests/test_money.py`).

## Review
Requesting review from @alex. Note that merging to `main` requires code-owner approval — I'll hold off on the merge.
